items.rationale: The fixed unit is covered for lightning overvoltage under 2.3.3 and 4.2.3, and at nine metres from the hob it falls outside the five-metre exclusion. Under 7.1.9–7.1.10, one replacement is valued at €1,411 gross for the pre-loss 3.5 kW equivalent, not the upgraded 7.1 kW model.
Sections 7.1.9(c) and 7.1.10 cover ordinary installation at the pre-loss standard, but not any extra labour attributable to the upgrade. One installation at the reference rate is €482 gross.

Section 7.1.10 excludes the entire console charge because it was chosen for appearance and was not required to install the replacement. The €60 gross estimate is conditional only, using one console from the reference case.
Sections 7.1.9(e), 7.1.11 and 7.1.12 cover ordinary carriage of the equivalent replacement, with the express premium billed separately. One ordinary shipment is €42 gross at the reference rate.
Section 7.1.12 excludes the express and timed delivery premium because neither advance approval nor a need to prevent further loss is shown. The conditional estimate for one surcharge is €50 gross.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed contractor administration and paperwork charges. The conditional estimate for one flat fee is €45 gross.
